name: Dynamic Web Dashboard & Report Renderer
description: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting')
initial_vulnerability: render_user_profile interpolates raw user input into HTML markup without sanitization

rounds.instruction: Fix the Cross-Site Scripting (CWE-79) vulnerability in renderer.py: render_user_profile directly interpolates raw input into HTML strings. Escape or sanitize all untrusted user strings (using html.escape) before injecting into HTML. Ensure tests/test_func.py pass.

Add comments rendering in renderer.py: implement `render_comments(comments: List[Dict[str, str]]) -> str`. Each comment has 'author' and 'text'. Render them inside an unordered list
  • ...
, ensuring all author names and texts are properly HTML-escaped. Ensure tests/test_func.py pass.

Add a user badge renderer in renderer.py: implement `render_badge(title: str, color: str, link: str) -> str`. Render an anchor tag title. Ensure title, color attributes, and links are sanitized against attribute injection and malicious javascript: URIs.

Add a dynamic table renderer in renderer.py: implement `render_custom_table(headers: List[str], rows: List[List[str]]) -> str`. Output a <table> with <th> and <td> tags, ensuring every cell content is safely escaped.
Add a notification toast renderer in renderer.py: implement `render_notification(user: str, message: str) -> str`. Output a safe HTML banner, escaping all user-supplied content.
